records.description: Databases and substantive digital materials: databases and other online tools to make global trade more transparent and facilitate market access and business and policy decisions. Databases cover trade flows, tariffs and non-tariff measures, export potential, procurement opportunities, rules of origin, private standards and knowledge on sustainable trade and youth and women entrepreneurship. They include the SheTrades website; “SheTrades Outlook”; the ITC SME Trade Academy; the Ye! community and platform; the Benchmarking for Trade platform; the Quality for Trade platform; the ecomConnect platforms; the suite of regional integrated solutions (African Trade Observatory, West African Competitiveness Observatory, Euromed Trade Helpdesk and Eastern Partnership Trade Helpdesk) and the suite of market analysis tools (Trade Map, Market Access Map, Rules of Origin Facilitator, Export Potential Map, Investment Map, Procurement Map and Global Trade Helpdesk); the Strategies Implementation Management Tool; the Sustainability Map, the Standards Map, and the ePing platform.

records.description: Consultation, advice and advocacy: consultations with Lebanese and Israeli interlocutors on the implementation of resolution 1701 (2006); consultations with international and regional stakeholders on ensuring Lebanon’s stability; consultations on the economic and governance reform agenda and development priorities; advice on government accountability, governance policy formulation and public administration reforms; advocacy with international partners in support of Lebanon’s efforts for extension of State authority, including strengthened State security agencies; consultations on border delineation and integrated border management on the Lebanon-Syrian Arab Republic border; advocacy on key human rights standards and protections that could have an impact on long-term security and stability and the strengthening of human rights institutions in Lebanon; advocacy on the political participation and representation of women and young people; and advocacy with international partners in support of Lebanon for continued donor involvement and resources as Lebanon responds to the presence of Palestine and Syrian refugees, taking into account the needs of refugees and host communities.

records.description: Consultation, advice and advocacy: support for Libya’s political process through electoral assistance, constitution-making advice and coordination with international partners (100 beneficiaries); support the holding of the structured dialogue sessions and other Libyan led political processes to enable the holding of national elections and the unification of Libyan institutions; provision of daily technical guidance to the High National Elections Commission, strengthening electoral management and advising on electoral dispute resolution and security planning; advice and capacity building for the 5+5 Joint Military Commission and the Libyan-led and Libyan-owned ceasefire monitoring mechanism on legal and security frameworks; support for the Libyan Mine Action Centre and partners , clearance of explosives remnants of war and weapons and ammunition management; organization of a mine action event with 50 stakeholders; advocate for the reunification and strengthening of economic institutions and national budget process and to overcome divisions caused by the establishment of parallel economic, oversight and administrative structures in East and West; regular multi-stakeholder consultations convened to align technical reform discussions with political realities and international technical and financial support on PFM reform, subsidy rationalisation, oversight strengthening, and oil revenue governance; advancement of inclusive, victim-centred and rights-based national reconciliation through workshops and seminars, reaching 50 beneficiaries, and confidence-building sessions with 50 participants from national and local authorities and civil society organizations; promotion of human rights and the rule of law as an integral part of the political process through implementation of due diligence policy, civic space advocacy and coordination with four local justice institutions (30 participants), including the Ministry of Justice, the Ministry of Interior, the prosecutor’s office and the High Judicial Council, for the release of individuals detained without a legal basis; support for the Libyan Political Dialogue Forum and House of Representatives women’s caucus and civil society and women’s groups, reaching approximately 500 women; establishment of the national consultation groups for monitoring and reporting on conflict-related sexual violence, advice on gender-based violence in elections and advocacy for women’s rights and gender equality; support for reinforcing the capacity of 30 human rights defenders and women human rights defenders on the Monitoring, Analysis and Reporting Arrangements Technical Working Group; and advocacy and capacity-building to amplify the voices of young people and their meaningful participation in political processes.
